description: The Trip End Model Presentation Program (TEMPro) is software provided through the UK Department for Transport for viewing and analysing National Trip End Model (NTEM) information. The official distribution page identifies trip-end forecasts and associated documentation and links the version 8.1 setup and documentation package. Users can analyse the forecast data by geographical area, transport mode, travel time of day, journey purpose, year of interest and trip type. The source states a year range of 2011 to 2051. These functions support selection and interpretation of transport-demand modelling inputs. TEMPro is recorded as a supporting data-preparation tool; the inspected page does not establish an independent traffic solver, demand-calculation algorithm or export function. Geographic coverage follows the underlying NTEM release; the landing description does not specify the available area hierarchy or spatial resolution. The public metadata and software-package link are accessible, but the software licence, source-code availability and reuse charges are not stated. Code availability is therefore unknown. The setup archive and documentation were not downloaded, installed or executed. A limitation is that supported operating systems, input and output schemas, interface details and numerical accuracy have not been established from the inspected metadata. The source supplies separate email contacts for support and software/data updates; no contact was initiated. This record describes the viewer, with the underlying NTEM forecasts as related data and distinct from them and the National Transport Model.
